regions.today: Starting off dry and bright in places. Through the morning cloud will increase with showers or spells of rain developing. Downpours will turn heavy or squally at times with the potential for thunderstorms or localised flooding. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, with mostly light to moderate southeasterly breezes, gusty at times around heavy showers.
regions.tonight: A mix of clear spells and isolated showers. Lowest temperatures of 10 to12 degrees, with moderate to fresh westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Monday will continue breezy but mostly dry apart from the odd isolated shower. Occasional sunny spells will develop, turning more hazy through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in moderate to fresh west winds.
